title: the preview of --remove never prints a user line whose only change is the comma it loses
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup hook, defect N-17): jitso registers its guard in the project's .claude/settings.json without clobbering anything
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-17, setup hook). Taking out the last key of the root object (`hooks`) makes the key before it lose its trailing comma, so a line diff shows that user line as removed and added. For this sensitive file the preview prints only lines jitso wrote (here the removed handler, with its `jitso hook guard` command): the user line shows as the one marker line `~ (a line of the existing file changes only by a comma; not shown)`, never its text.

stdout: ~ (a line of the existing file changes only by a comma; not shown)

stdout.regex: jitso setup hook: dry run, nothing written\n$
